Add JSON Patch (RFC 6902)

applyPatch(document, patch) applies add, remove, replace, move, copy and
test operations and returns a new document; neither input is mutated, so
a failing patch leaves nothing half-applied. The whole patch is validated
first. Errors extend JsonPatchError and carry the failing operation's
index: InvalidPatchError for a malformed patch, PatchConflictError when
an operation does not fit the document, PatchTestFailedError for a failed
test. ADR 0002 records the choices where the RFC leaves room.
